authors.bio: Michael Karagosian is the founder and president of MKPE Consulting LLC, a Los Angeles-based consultancy in the entertainment industry. He is a 30-year veteran of the cinema industry and has been active in the digital cinema space for the past decade. Karagosian serves as senior technology adviser to the National Association of Theatre Owners. He is a member of the board of directors for In-Three, and was an advisor to the U.K. Film Council in the U.K. government-financed rollout of digital cinema. In the late 1970s and early 1980s, Karagosian led the development of cinema and studio products at Dolby Laboratories, and later led the development of networked audio and control systems for Disney theme parks. He is the editor of mkpeReport (http://report.mkpe.com). His company site is http://mkpe.com.
